title: Equilibrium and non-equilibrium effects in high pressure phase transformations of carbon

comments: ML-enhanced simulations efficiently explore extreme-condition phase space, but validation against static high-pressure diamond anvil experiments limited; applicability to planetary interiors requires equation-of-state refinement.

title: Direct observation of diamond formation in a shock-compressed high explosive
task: Observe and characterize ultrafast diamond formation in shock-compressed TATB explosive

comments: First direct nanosecond-scale observation of diamond nucleation in reacting TATB is significant for extreme-condition chemistry, but limited to single material system; generalization to other explosives unclear.
